newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: National Property to place units.
newsitem.headline: National Property to place units.

text.p: National Property Trust Ltd said on Tuesday it would place up to 4.4 million new units to "professional investors" to assist in funding the NZ$15.7 million purchase of a Wellington property, NCR House.
The trust has entered into a conditional contract to purchase all of the shares in 342 Lambton Quay Ltd, subject to the raising of satisfactory finance, including the placement.
The new units will be placed at 90 cents per unit providing $3,960,000 less the cost of the placement.
The placement is subject to the approval of unit holders at an EGM on September 16.
ANZ Bank has approved additional borrowing facilities of $9 million, bringing the Trust's total debt funding to $18.5 million.
After the acquisition the total borrowing of the trust is projected to be 33.8 percent, compared with its borrowing limit of 35 percent of the gross value of the trust fund.
